entities.summary: Shumerlya is a town in the Chuvash Republic, Russia, located on the right bank of the Sura River on the Nizhny Novgorod–Ulyanovsk highway. Population: 31,722 (2010 census); 36,239 (2002 census); 41,986 (1989 Soviet census); 35,000 (1974).
